interface.record: {format, candidate:{id, class: sharing|frame-storage, replaces:{kind: operation|representation, reference}}, reference:{profile}, preservation_predicate:{statement, file (committed), entry (pub fn of file)}, clauses:[{observation, statement, status: evidenced|gap|evidenced-with-gaps, evidence:[id], gaps:[id]}] for EXACTLY values, rejection-exhaustion, evaluation-effect-order, boundaries, duties, resource-schedule; costs:[{metric, status: measured|unmeasured|unchanged-by-construction, evidence, gaps}] including logical-work, logical-allocation, physical-bytes, rows-degree, proof-key-sizes, host-time, host-memory, dust (unmeasured needs a gap; others need evidence); evidence:[{id, kind: receipt|holdout-replay, receipt?}], unresolved_gaps:[{id, statement, clauses:[the planes/metrics citing it]}], acceptance: none}
interface.separation: evidence ids and gap ids disjoint; every evidence item cited; each gap's clauses equal exactly the planes/metrics citing it
interface.receipt: committed JSON {format:'moriarty-sherlock-optimization-receipt/1', candidate, file (candidate source), commit (40-hex ancestor of HEAD), run (qa/sherlock/runs.jsonl id: exit 0, head==commit, cmd==command, same trace), trace, trace_sha256, command ('cargo test ...'), tests:[{name, file, role: preserves|detects-violation}], passed, failed:0}; tests are #[test] fns calling a pub fn of file, the detects-violation test asserts a detected violation; files unchanged since commit
interface.replay: --optimization CANDIDATE on mori simulate (draft route) applies the candidate and adds `optimization` {format:'moriarty-sherlock-optimization-run/1', candidate, applied:bool, logical:{counter:{reference,candidate}} (must be equal), physical:{metric:{reference,candidate}}}. The holdout replays its own sealed specimens under reference and candidate: equal value, summary (work/events/outcome), tasks, --reference-slices 1 stream, exact-fuel/short-fuel/stack-1/partial-fuel outcomes; at least one equal-subtree specimen must show applied=true and a physical reduction
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25) from the spec, interfaces.md and demonstrators.md; implementer proposals reviewed. The holdout reads the flags below; a spelling change is a CONTRACT CHANGE posted to sherlock-eval. Adopted sherlock-c4's record format (sherlock-optimization-preservation/1) with amendments: plane ids fixed, cost list fixed, receipt format, mandatory replay flag. c4's model_package.py optimization-record checker is not used by the holdout.
